status: HARNESS FIRST RED: verified text was never submitted and the input ingress stopped accepting virtual or physical RETURN
mechanism: The verified-input helper observed the exact active form (m65-sprite-shape 0 s), but m65 returned success without delivering RETURN. Both the explicit ~M route and the empty -T route left the screen byte-identical. A synchronized register/stack capture placed the CPU in c2_kernal_event_poll returning to lisp_input_event with vm_status=OK and gc_rootsp=0; the sprite slot remained wholly unchanged. One later physical RETURN also left the active line and slot byte-identical. The sprite call never began; the REPL input ingress was wedged before submission.

synchronized_cpu.interpretation: idle input wait with stale last-code owner, not an executing sprite call

disposition: Cold-reset the invalid input state. Reduce the setup transport before the unchanged sprite call and retain exact post-form result checks. Product and Link-89 bytes remain unchanged.
claim_limit: A submission/input-ingress failure after the listed partial D1 rows. It proves no failure in m65-sprite-shape, VIC/SID hardware, the Ship sample, trailing D3 rows, release or promotion.
